_help.how: One entry per price source. Run `python -m pricecheck_connectors discover <site>` on your laptop, paste its suggestion here, check with `run <name> --dry-run --limit 5`, then set enabled: true.
_help.types: site_pages = read product pages from the sitemap | platform_api = Shopify/WooCommerce JSON catalogue | csv_feed = CSV file or published Google Sheet (manual checks, official chain feeds)
_help.source: feed | receipt | manual | online | aggregator  (trust order, most trusted first)
_help.regex: Last-resort extraction: {"price": "class=\"price\"[^>]*>\\s*KES\\s*([\\d,.]+)", "old_price": "..."} with one ( ) group each
_help.politeness: delay_seconds between requests to the same site; robots.txt is always respected

carrefour_site._note: Checked 2026-11-20: product pages carry schema.org JSON-LD with the current price (no 'was' price). BUT carrefour.ke stalls plain automated requests (timeouts) even from a Kenyan connection, while a real browser loads instantly. Needs a browser-based fetcher before enabling; meanwhile use manual checks.

naivas_site._note: Checked 2026-11-20: robots.txt allows us, but prices are not in the public HTML; the site loads them from a private app API after the page opens. No public route: use manual checks now, and ask Naivas for a feed.

quickmart_site._note: Checked 2026-11-20 from a Kenyan connection: server-rendered product pages /<name>-<number> (slug is the id: numbers repeat across products), listed in /sitemap/list_N.xml (~14,000 pages incl. brand and category pages, which simply return no price). Price in products-price-new, offer 'was' price in products-price-old right after it. robots.txt allows us.

chandarana_site._note: Checked 2026-11-20: foodplus.co.ke robots.txt disallows crawlers like ours. Respect it: manual checks now, and ask Chandarana for a feed.

manual_checks._note: Google Sheet from scrapers/templates/manual_prices.csv, published as CSV (File > Share > Publish to web > CSV). Put that link in the MANUAL_SHEET_CSV_URL secret.
